name: awsh
description: The awdk Claude Code plugin: the `aw` subagent, Aither World skills, the aither output style, brick MCP servers and portable hooks. Install: /plugin marketplace add Aitherium/awdk, then /plugin install awsh@awsh. For the Aitherium connector and setup skill: /plugin install aitherium@awsh.

plugins.name: awsh
